Name: Sir Evan Petlia, The Ironwood Knight

Voice: regal knight, a bit over the top, "My lady! (bows deeply) What a great and divine honor to see you again, fight in the light of the Green Mother."

Description: 6 foot tall human, wears armor with green gilding and a helmet with a large green and blue feather. He wields an axe and shield. His plate has a great gray tree, an Ironwood tree. Evan is generous and kind, a better man than he is a lord or knight, and rules his town fairly, he is powerful among men but does not enjoy violence.

Important Info: Lord of Petlia (town), friend of the Young Wolves and Alabaster. Member of the Knights of Leaves.
